subject: Post-call: PulseCare eval plan & dataset spec for Redwood fit check
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sara Briggs <sara@pulsecare.ai>, PulseCare Data Team <data@pulsecare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: PulseCare eval plan & dataset spec for Redwood fit check

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight plan to validate model fit on Redwood so your engineering team can judge latency, cost, and quality: 

1) Goal: Run a targeted evaluation that mirrors your triage flow (user triage -> recommended next action) to surface model quality gaps and token cost estimates.

2) Recommended candidate models to try first (tradeoffs noted):
   - Llama 2 chat 13B (fast inference, strong instruction-following for short contexts) — good baseline.
   - Mistral-Instruct-7B (compact, strong instruction quality; lower token cost in our benchmarks for few-shot prompts).
   - rw-13b-q4f16 (Redwood-verified quantized variant) — best cost/latency balance for throughput tests.

3) What we'll run:
   - Small benchmark (200–500 seeded examples) using your canonical prompts + edge-case set.
   - Full eval (up to 5k examples) if the small benchmark looks promising.
   - Scoring: exact match where appropriate, plus a rubric-based quality score (0–3) for action correctness, hallucination, and safety. See attached rubric.

4) Data & format: attached is a CSV spec (pulsecare_dataset_spec.csv) and a sample prompt set (pulsecare_eval_prompts.csv). The columns we prefer: id, prompt, expected_response, label, confidence, metadata. If you can't include PHI, anonymize or replace identifiers; product team guidance below.

5) Timeline: once we have a 200–500 example sample, typical turnaround is 3–5 business days to run the small benchmark (includes model runs, basic scoring, and a brief recap doc). Full run times scale with size — we'll share estimated cost before running.

6) Next steps (proposed):
   - Sara: share a 200–500 example sample by S3 upload or Drive link (I included a Drive place-holder here for convenience).
   - PulseCare: confirm whether the sample contains PHI so we can advise on private deployment / redaction guidance.
   - Redwood: schedule a 30-min technical sync (Marissa + Priyom) to walk file format and access options.

Attached: pulsecare_eval_prompts.csv, pulsecare_dataset_spec.csv, pulsecare_scoring_rubric.md
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-doc-id-pulsecare-eval
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/PC-2026-11-01

Happy to adjust — flag anything missing and I’ll update the plan.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---

From: Sara Briggs <sara@pulsecare.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: PulseCare Data Team <data@pulsecare.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: PulseCare eval plan & dataset spec for Redwood fit check

Thanks Aditya — this is exactly the level of detail we wanted. A few quick clarifications before we pull the sample: 

- Our sample will likely include PHI (patient initials and short notes). Can you confirm redaction guidance and whether the small benchmark can run on Hosted safely?
- For the scoring rubric: can we add a "clinical risk" column to the rubric where evaluators mark high/med/low risk for incorrect suggestions?

We can prepare a 300-item sample and aim to upload by Friday. Also, do you need API keys for direct S3 access or would you prefer a Drive link?

—Sara
Sara Briggs
Head of Data & Analytics | PulseCare
sara@pulsecare.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Briggs <sara@pulsecare.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: PulseCare eval plan & dataset spec for Redwood fit check

Hi Sara — Marissa from Solutions/CS here, thanks for the questions. Quick answers and guidance: 

1) PHI & data handling:
   - For samples that include PHI we strongly recommend one of two approaches: a) anonymize/redact fields (preferred for hosted evals), or b) use Redwood Private (VPC) for evaluation where the data never leaves your VPC and keys are customer-managed.
   - Our hosted environment does not index customer content; it is used transiently for inference and logs can be configured/disabled. We are SOC 2 Type II. See: https://redwood.com/security/soc2 (link to detailed controls).

2) Technical upload options:
   - S3: we can provide a pre-signed upload URL (fastest).
   - Drive: acceptable for small samples; we can pull from a shared Drive if you add redwood-eval@redwood.com.

3) Scoring / rubric:
   - Happy to add a "clinical_risk" column to the rubric and treat it as a gating feature for high-risk categories. For the final scoring we'll produce both automatic metrics and a small human-reviewed sample (20–50 examples) for edge-case adjudication.

4) Data format details (please follow these exactly for the eval runner):
   - CSV columns: id, prompt, expected_response, label, confidence, metadata.
   - Prompt conventions: keep prompts <= 1024 tokens for the small benchmark; include any instruction prefix you plan to use in production.

5) Timeline & costs:
   - 300-example small run: 3 business days after data receipt. Estimated token cost and total bill will be shared for sign-off prior to full run.

If you'd like, schedule the 30-min technical sync for Thursday morning — I can walk the team through the CSV and sample upload.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick replies. Two quick confirmations: 

- We will accept a Drive upload for the 300-example sample; please add redwood-eval@redwood.com and I will confirm when we pull it.
- We'll add the clinical_risk column to the rubric (Marissa will send an updated rubric attached in a follow-up).

Proposed slots for the 30-min technical sync: Thu 12/03 10:00am PT or Thu 12/03 2:00pm PT — which works for you? Once you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and a HubSpot task for the deal.

Thanks — looking forward to the sample.

Aditya
